observation.command:
CTX=/tmp/g_berichtskonfigurator
# ensure shared services present and paths rewritten (already done by helper)
grep -n 'COPY 03-shared-services' $CTX/Dockerfile
# Replace injected COPY with one that chowns to bmi_user (uid)
sed -i 's|COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/|COPY --chown=bmi_user 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/|g' $CTX/Dockerfile
grep -n '03-shared-services' $CTX/Dockerfile
